subject.title: [Bug]: Slack thread-session-key ACP binding routing test fails deterministically on main

question: Should this protected Slack ACP binding routing issue be closed as fixed on current main based on the current source path and the latest passing repro comment?
rationale: The source and discussion now point to the central failure being resolved, but the live `maintainer` label is a protected human-handling signal that this cleanup workflow must not override.

options.title: Close After Maintainer Confirmation
options.body: A maintainer confirms the focused repro is green on the exact current head, removes or overrides the protected-label block, and closes this as fixed on main.

options.title: Keep Protected And Request Fresh Failure Output
options.body: If maintainers suspect a different failure mode, keep the issue open and ask for the current failing equality diff, OS, Node version, and exact head SHA.

recommendation.title: Close After Maintainer Confirmation
recommendation.body: A maintainer confirms the focused repro is green on the exact current head, removes or overrides the protected-label block, and closes this as fixed on main.
